description: Microsoft Building Footprints is a data set deposited in harvardu.crisis by its authors Microsoft. The MS Buildings dataset on the Microsoft Planetary Computer provides high-resolution, global building footprints derived from satellite imagery. It is designed to support applications like urban planning, disaster response, and climate change mitigation. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
